diagrams.title: System context

diagrams.title: Evidence extraction

diagrams.title: Model Router
diagrams.description: Task routing, budget guard, response cache, adapters, validation and usage logging, with no automatic cross-provider fallback.

diagrams.title: Guideline engine
diagrams.description: Version lifecycle with Guideline Studio dry run, deterministic evaluation, the seven outcomes and the resulting cases.

diagrams.title: Care gap case lifecycle
diagrams.description: The thirteen case statuses and their transitions, plus the deterministic priority rules.

diagrams.title: Capacity planning
diagrams.description: OR-Tools CP-SAT planning with priority and equity objectives, consent and capacity constraints, validation and a first come baseline.

diagrams.description: Simulated outreach and the resident conversation safety flow: classifier, model, reply checks, escalation and the emergency override.

diagrams.title: Loop closure
diagrams.description: Completion evidence, reference check and second person verification, with the authorised exception path.

diagrams.title: Consent enforcement
diagrams.description: The append only consent ledger and the six places it is enforced.

diagrams.title: Ask Anticipa
diagrams.description: Grounded natural language analytics: pre-filter, read only tools, numeric grounding check, server built charts and refusals.

diagrams.title: Analytics snapshot and caching
diagrams.description: Snapshot refresh triggers, single row reads, ETag and Cache-Control, and the client stale while revalidate cache.

diagrams.title: Authentication and RBAC

diagrams.title: Deployment topology

diagrams.title: FHIR mapping and write-back
diagrams.description: How Synthea resources and Anticipa rows become FHIR R4 resources in HAPI through idempotent transaction bundles.

diagrams.title: Evaluation harness
diagrams.description: Isolated ground truth, dev and test splits, a deliberate final run, metrics, gates and reporting.

diagrams.title: India geography drill down
diagrams.description: Country, state and district levels with the ten synthetic pilot districts.

diagrams.description: Seven layers of defence from the edge to identity, authorization, data, AI safety, audit and publishing.
